issue.title: Union Type inference not working in class (ts version 1.4)

system_prompt: You are a helpful AI assistant who classifies GitHub issues according to predefined categories. Your goal is to determine if the GitHub issue can be reproduced to verify the provided solution's correctness.

I'll analyze this GitHub issue about TypeScript union type inference in classes.

CATEGORY: 1
REASONING: This issue is purely related to TypeScript's type system and can be verified without a build environment. The problem is that TypeScript 1.4 (as of 2015) wasn't correctly narrowing union types within class methods. The error message "Property 'forEach' does not exist on type 'string | string[]'" indicates that TypeScript isn't recognizing that the else branch can only be reached when this.name is a string array. This is a type checking issue that can be verified by analyzing the code and understanding TypeScript's type inference capabilities. A solution would likely involve either using type assertions or updating to a newer TypeScript version where union type narrowing works correctly in classes. This verification can be done through code analysis without needing to build or run the code, as it's a compile-time type checking issue rather than a runtime behavior issue.
